svg.aria-label: Full-TAM Map workflow, top to bottom
svg.text: TRIGGER An ICP file and at least two data sources
OUTCOME Every company that fits, with a count you can trust
Sub-vertical, headcount band, geography, buyer title, must-have tech, and the sources that can see
run as a people search on the same
5 to 10 seed domains at standard similarity, headcount
and country matching the segment, paginated to the end
Indexed from the open web rather than LinkedIn, so its
count is a better gauge of the true market
Exact category by city for local or owner-operated
segments, counted before anything is paid for
Licensing registries, association member lists and
public job feeds, pulled broad and filtered later
Dedupe by domain, then company name plus state, then phone; keep every source that saw the company
Qualify on the website, detect the stack
Homepage plus about page, a yes or no ICP verdict with
one reason from a cheap model, before any paid people
Saved homepage HTML searched for the vendors the ICP
Size, write and schedule the refresh
Qualified companies times buyers per company; over 100K contacts test broadly, under 30K go
Every company to the CRM or sheet with segment, source, verdict and tech columns; raw pulls kept;
Every company that fits, with a count you can trust
